description:
Use this when the user asks what events are scheduled or happened across Indian markets in any date window: results, board meetings, dividends, splits.

Returns disclosed events across all companies in a date window, past or future: board meetings for results, corporate actions, and IPO opening, closing and listing dates. `date_from` defaults to today and `date_to` to 30 days later; the window is at most 180 days. `types` filters to a list from: results, ipo, dividend, bonus, split, consolidation, rights, buyback, demerger, spinoff, merger, distribution, other. `limit` is 1 to 2000 (default 150). A list that was cut says so: ask again with `date_from` set to the last date returned, or with fewer `types`. An event's date is the board-meeting date for results, the ex-date for a corporate action, and the opening, closing or listing date for an IPO. For one company's actions use get_corporate_actions.

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or after date_from, at most 180 days later. Defaults to 30 days after date_from.
date_to.title: Date To

types.description: Event types to include, e.g. results, dividend, ipo. Also accepts index_review (announced index changes not yet effective), returned only when named here.
types.title: Types

name: get_market_calendar
title: Market calendar
